description: Show the user a preview of a post before it is published: how it reads on each account, with its length against the platform limit, its media and its time, and a Publish (or Schedule) button. Pass `post`: the exact input you would give social.post.create. Call it instead of asking "shall I publish?" in text. The user publishes from the preview, and you are told when they do: never call social.post.create yourself for that post afterwards. If they ask for changes, call preview_post again with the new input. Free.

post.description: The social.post.create input: channels, text, media, when, overrides…

name: preview_post
